description: Converts and exports a YouTube transcript formatted as plain text (txt), SubRip subtitle (srt), or WebVTT (vtt).

format.description: Desired export format: "txt" (clean plain text), "txt_with_timestamps", "srt" (SubRip), or "vtt" (WebVTT).

url_or_video_id.description: The YouTube video URL or 11-character video ID.

name: export_youtube_transcript
